exam_scheme.note: The All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) is conducted annually by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the Ministry of AYUSH, the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM), and the National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH). AIAPGET is the single gateway examination for admission into MD / MS / Postgraduate Diploma courses in Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy systems of medicine across all AYUSH medical colleges, state universities, and national institutes in India. The examination is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 120 minutes (2 hours) duration comprising 120 multiple-choice questions (480 marks). Marking scheme: +4 marks for each correct answer; -1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking); 0 for unanswered.
